name: Strange Reality Structural Codex
purpose: Expose familiar-but-underused real-world structures as heterogeneous priors and test whether they deform model architecture search space.
core_hypothesis: A model can possess factual knowledge of a phenomenon without routinely using its relational structure as an architecture prior; structured re-reading may increase the probability of non-default architecture hypotheses.
execution_policy: Conceptual and sandbox-only. Reading material never authorizes external action.
